featured_reviews.name: Hiral Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
I ordered an acrylic One Direction lamp from this store as a gift, and it was absolutely perfect for any music fan! The design includes a Spotify scan code that links to a complete One Direction playlist — such a thoughtful touch. The lamp itself is just the right size: not too big, not too small (about 6 inches wide and 5 inches tall), and looks really cute.

What impressed me even more was the customer service. Their call centre was very responsive and answered all my queries promptly. I had mentioned during the order that it was for a special occasion, and they went the extra mile by including a One Direction-themed card in a well packed cardboard box with the product.

To top it all off, the lamp was delivered within just 2 hours of placing the order! They also have a great selection of other adorable collectibles like mugs, magnets, and more. I’ll definitely be ordering again soon.

Once again Thank you to Vatsal and team at the Peppy Store.

featured_reviews.name: Kailesh Ved
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the best-managed and most responsible electronic stores in Mumbai. I would rate it among the finest supermarkets across Mumbai and the suburbs. They have everything — from basic home essentials to mobile phones, white goods, and even Smart Home Automation. Their focus on quality is clear from the premium brands they stock.

The store is run by young and dynamic entrepreneurs, Manishji and Rajeshbhai, guided by their highly respected father Pankajbhai. Their values, tradition, and humble attitude truly set them apart. The staff is well-organised, professional, and always ready to guide you with the right product suggestions.

I’ve been a customer for over 28 years and have seen their dedication and growth firsthand. Despite their success, the family remains humble, polite, and extremely customer-friendly.

Highly recommended. Wishing them continued success.

Namaskar Kailesh Ved,

We are truly humbled by your exceptional review and grateful for your loyalty to our store. We are thrilled to hear that you rate us among the finest supermarkets in Mumbai and the suburbs. Our focus on quality and customer satisfaction is evident from the premium brands we stock, and we are proud to offer a wide range of products from basic home essentials to cutting-edge technology.

We appreciate your kind words about our team, led by Manishji, Rajeshbhai, and Pankajbhai. Their dedication to our values, tradition, and customer-centric approach has been instrumental in our growth and success. Our staff is indeed well-organised, professional, and committed to providing the best possible shopping experience for our customers.

We are grateful for your loyalty and appreciation for our store, and we are committed to continuing to provide exceptional service and products to our valued customers like you. Thank you for your recommendation and for wishing us continued success.

Warm Regards,
Team Zee Novelties
